text: [outro music] My name is Steven Schrembeck. And my name is Joshua Swenson. So in 2022, a series of UFO sightings forced me to completely reevaluate everything I thought I knew about how reality worked, and I began obsessively researching, training, learning literally everything I could in a desperate reaction to just understand my reality. So I spent years seeking answers to the kinds of questions that nobody actually expects to get answers to. Are we alone? Why am I here? Am I going to die? How does reality itself work? But I did it as a sort of need to make sense of what was happening. Imagine my surprise when I actually get a reply. Uh, to pretty much all of them. Clear, direct, testable answers. We are presenting those answers as I experienced them, how I got to them, what the implications are for our reality, and more importantly it's everything I know about how to do it yourself, because I fundamentally believe that anyone can do this too. And if it's true, it should be verifiable. I'll be holding space for this incredible exploration, occasionally playing the skeptic and fellow explorer, pushing back, helping Steven go deeper, trying things out myself, and reporting back.
